result.justification: The study clearly articulates its objective to investigate the impact of TTSuV1 coinfection on IAV pathology, supported by a detailed methodology.

evidence.quote: the primary objective of this study was to evaluate the impact of TTSuV1 coinfection on the replication and pathology of the influenza A/CA/2009 (H1N1) virus
Twenty-eight mice were randomly distributed by the operators into one of four groups as follows: I. Uninfected mice (N = 4), II. TTSuV1 only (N = 8), III. IAV only (N = 8), IV. TTSuV1 + IAV (N = 8)
